authority: Final reviewed releases, followed by the November 5 Tradition amendment; preserve original text and historical IDs.
rules: No minimum effect size. Existence of a supported reason is separate from comparative strength.
Every argument is shown; no early stopping.
Only genuinely reused, substantively disputed claims or exact unresolved support gaps receive separate votes.
Direct bill provisions and adequately supported unchallenged claims are sourced context, never automatic Yes.
Combined necessary premises are AND; independent routes are OR.
CON targets actual necessary premise or inference; baseline, magnitude, no earmark or no bill-specific observation alone is insufficient.
Tradition requires identifiable inherited practice and continuity, not generic religiously endorsed morality.
Societal Security concerns collective/state protective capacity, not relabeled isolated individual harms.
Tolerance requires substantive understanding/acceptance across relevant differences, not generic information or compassion.
ESL wording assumes little or no prior policy/legal/US-government knowledge.
Validity qualifications accompany reasoning; size/timing/reach goes to Both-only comparison; editorial history stays in audit.
superseded: Main-effect eligibility thresholds, four separate check questions, close-call follow-ups and required explanations.
Separate votes on every reused provision, uncontested possibility or adequately supported unchallenged statement.
Separate Main effect panel, usage lists on claim pages, dependency-flag control, and evidence-notes/gaps panels.
protection: No keys, manuscript judgments, coder records, Qualtrics changes, live brief changes, or S.1582 saved-state changes.
current_shared_claim_rule: Only genuinely reused, substantively disputed claims or exact unresolved support gaps receive separate votes. Direct provisions and adequately supported unchallenged statements are sourced context.
